title: Way More Gear
description: just a bit more gear than usual...
body:
**_READ DESC FOR HOW TO USE_**

To get 100% of the function, use with WMR (Way More Recipes), To get the recipes say /grantgear in chat. This mod was made for april fools or something idk I forgot.

 
**
Adds a few more GEAR than usual..**

 

Have YOU ever wanted to have EMERALD ARMOR? Well, Now you have it! Did you say you wanted Debug Stick armor?! I gotchu bro. 
This mod adds 

- COPPER 
- EMERALD 
- DEBUG STICK 
- waste 
- and LIGHT 

tools! (and soon enough armor but it bugged out so only light armor exists :skull:)

 

_All you have to do is craft.
